notes: §1985:VIII.3.2.2 gives the relative FD BLOCK CONTAINS, the three RECORD formats ('IS VARYING IN SIZE' with DEPENDING ON), LABEL RECORD(S) STANDARD/OMITTED, VALUE OF and DATA RECORD(S), in any order (SR2), followed by one or more records (SR3). The grammar parses each and FileDescriptionFormats#Rows with FileDescriptionClauseAdmitted refuse the others on a relative FD (LINAGE, CODE-SET, REPORT: COBOL2604); VisitRecordClause refuses the 2023 BYTES (COBOL0900); MaterializeImpliedRecord refuses an FD with no record (COBOL1837). Probes at 85 with an ODO record: every legal combination writes and reads back (W 00 / R 00); a doubled BLOCK or RECORD clause (COBOL2423), BLOCK 0 (COBOL2386), FROM 10 TO 3 (COBOL2009), records outside the range (COBOL2010), a non-integer DEPENDING ON (COBOL2922), LABEL ... IGNORED, VALUE OF without implementor-name, DATA RECORD naming a 77 (COBOL6849) are refused. The witness runs all five clauses and reads HELLO back. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming kb/Work PB5070 (landed); the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5070 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-10.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-10-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985 relative FD allows BLOCK CONTAINS, RECORD, LABEL RECORD(S) STANDARD/OMITTED, VALUE OF implementor-name-1 and DATA RECORD(S). §2023:13.4.5.2 Format 2 'relative-or-indexed' (§2023:13.4.5.3 SR7) keeps BLOCK CONTAINS (§2023:13.18.10.2) and the record-clause (§2023:13.18.43.2, BYTES a synonym per §2023:13.18.43.3 SR2) but has no LABEL, VALUE OF or DATA RECORDS clause anywhere in the standard, so a 1985 relative FD using them is refused. EXTERNAL/GLOBAL are not new (1985 X.4.2.2). CHANGED (stricter).
